verifiedProduct.baselineResult: 76 existing tests passed; only the new dot-ID containment test failed because evidenceFilePath('.') did not throw.
verifiedProduct.rootCause: validateId allowed '.' and '..' because both match [A-Za-z0-9._-]+, letting runDir collapse to the evidence root or its parent before file containment checks.
verifiedProduct.fix: Reject exactly '.' and '..' at the shared evidence-ID validation boundary; preserve all other previously accepted ID characters.
